skill.summary: Professional OKE security configuration generator based on CIS Benchmark standards.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Oracle OKE Security Hardening Tool.

- Provides an API to generate security-hardened Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE) configurations based on CIS Kubernetes Benchmark standards.
- Supports customizable hardening measures for RBAC, pod security, audit logging, secrets, and networking.
- Includes endpoints for configuration generation, option discovery, and service health checks.
- Returns comprehensive reports, compliance scores, and recommended security actions with each configuration.
- Offers tiered pricing plans to suit various usage levels.
